title: Localized range quotient equals scalar extension quotient
statement: For a commutative ring R, modules X,Y, linear map f, and prime ideal p, the quotient of LocalizedModule p.primeCompl Y by the localized range of f is A-linearly isomorphic to the quotient of the scalar extension of Y by the range of the scalar extension of f, where A=Localization.AtPrime p.

proof.text: Use LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct for Y and transport the localized range equality localized'_range_eq_range_localizedMap through the quotient; identify the resulting tensor product with ModuleCat.extendScalars.

lean.statement:
theorem localized_range_quotient_extendScalars
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (X Y : ModuleCat.{v} R) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (𝔭 : Ideal R) [𝔭.IsPrime] :
    Nonempty ((LocalizedModule 𝔭.primeCompl Y ⧸
        (LinearMap.range f.hom).localized 𝔭.primeCompl) ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭]
      (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).obj Y)
        ⧸ LinearMap.range ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).map f).hom))
